scope: Derived reviewed cells only; no new observations, no pooling across cohorts. Linux WSL2/ext4 only. Candidate flags and frozen source maps identify binaries; these are unmerged experiments.
caveats: Working-allocation reservations are not RSS caps.
Controlled temporary counters exclude private destination staging.
Kernel filesystem counters are not physical SSD bytes.
Cgroup memory.peak includes anonymous memory and file cache, not just RSS.

The 497MiB field-rich fixture has THREE columns, Unicode/quoted embedded newlines; an earlier plan label calling it four columns was wrong. The separate original2GiB cross-tool fixture has FOUR columns and no embedded field newlines.
Legacy paired harness features=[] placeholder is superseded by per-binary build manifests with exact hashes/features, not inferred from filenames.
